```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(wesanderson)
library(flextable)
library(janitor)
library(openxlsx)

dashboard <- read_csv("data/ca_dashboard.csv") %>% 
  filter(countyname == "Solano",
         districtname == params$district,
         reportingyear == params$year) %>%
  mutate(statuslevel = as_factor(statuslevel),
         # reportingyear = fct_relevel(as_factor(reportingyear), "2019"),
         indicator = fct_relevel(as_factor(indicator), 
                                 "ELA", "Math", "ELPI", 
                                 "absenteeism", "graduation", 
                                 "suspension"),
         studentgroup = as_factor(studentgroup),
         student_group_long = fct_relevel(as_factor(student_group_long),
                                    "All students",
                                    "American Indian or Alaska Native",
                                    "Asian",
                                    "Black/African American",
                                    "Filipino",
                                    "Hispanic",
                                    "Pacific Islander",
                                    "White",
                                    "Multiple Races/Two or more",
                                    "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
                                    "Homeless Youth",
                                    "Students with Disabilities",
                                    "Foster Youth",
                                    "English Learner",
                                    "English Learners Only",
                                    "RFEPs Only",
                                    "English Only",
                                    "Smarter Balanced Assessment",
                                    "CA Alternative Assessment"
                                    ),
         color = as_factor(color)) 


status_colors <- c(
  "lightgrey", "tomato", "orange",
  "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue", "darkgrey"
)
```

## `r params$initials` Needs Assessment Data Summary

This report summarizes LEA-level and/or student group results from the 2024 CA School Dashboard in support of the Learning Recovery Emergency Block Grant (LREBG).

```{r low_ela_schools}
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Schools where the All Students group has a status of low or very low in ELA."
#| tbl-cap-location: top

dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "S",
         studentgroup == "ALL",
         indicator == "ELA",
         statuslevel == "1" | statuslevel == "2") %>% 
  mutate(status_and_change  = case_match(statuslevel,
                                  "1" ~ 1 + changelevel,
                                  "2" ~ 2 + changelevel,
                                  .default = 0),
         statuslevel = case_match(statuslevel,
                                  "1" ~ "Very Low",
                                  "2" ~ "Low",
                                  .default = "Error"),
         changelevel = case_match(changelevel,
                                  1 ~ "Decreased Significantly",
                                  2 ~ "Decreased",
                                  3 ~ "Maintained",
                                  4 ~ "Increased",
                                  5 ~ "Increased Significantly",
                                  0 ~ "No Change Level")) %>% 
  arrange(status_and_change) %>% 
  select(schoolname, indicator, statuslevel, changelevel, currdenom) %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  set_header_labels(values = list(schoolname = "School Name",
                                  indicator = "Indicator",
                                  statuslevel = "Status",
                                  changelevel = "Change",
                                  currdenom = "Denominator")) %>% 
  width(width = c(2, 1.2, 0.8, 1, 0.8))

```

```{r high_absenteeism_schools}
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Schools where the All Students group has a status of high or very high for chronic absenteeism."
#| tbl-cap-location: top

dashboard %>% 
  filter(rtype == "S",
         studentgroup == "ALL",
         indicator == "absenteeism",
         statuslevel == "1" | statuslevel == "2") %>% 
  mutate(status_and_change  = case_match(statuslevel,
                                  "1" ~ 1 + changelevel,
                                  "2" ~ 2 + changelevel,
                                  .default = 0),
         statuslevel = case_match(statuslevel,
                                  "1" ~ "Very High",
                                  "2" ~ "High",
                                  .default = "Error"),
         changelevel = case_match(changelevel,
                                  5 ~ "Decreased Significantly",
                                  4 ~ "Decreased",
                                  3 ~ "Maintained",
                                  2 ~ "Increased",
                                  1 ~ "Increased Significantly",
                                  0 ~ "No Change Level")) %>% 
  arrange(status_and_change) %>% 
  select(schoolname, indicator, statuslevel, changelevel, currdenom, currnumer) %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  set_header_labels(values = list(student_group_long = "Student Group",
                                  indicator = "Indicator",
                                  statuslevel = "Status",
                                  changelevel = "Change",
                                  currnumer = "Numerator",
                                  currdenom = "Denominator")) %>% 
  width(width = c(1, 1.5, 0.6, 1, 0.8, 0.8))

```
